# OpenProgram 0.2.0 Release Notes

Original version date: April 1, 2026. The project was renamed from **LLM Agent Harness** to **Agentic Programming** in this version. This historical Release was added retroactively; no Git tag or downloadable installer existed for it.

## ✨ New features

- Added the `create()` meta function for generating an `@agentic_function` from a natural-language description.
- Added a restricted execution environment that limits imports and file I/O in generated code.
- Added `meta_demo.py` to demonstrate dynamic function creation.
- Defined separate Programmer and Runtime responsibilities and documented the design.
- Expanded multimodal input and conversation-content handling.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Renamed the project and Python package to Agentic Programming.
- Rewrote the README and design documentation to clarify the relationship among functions, the Runtime, and Context records.
- Reorganized the early Skills, examples, and repository layout.

## 📦 Availability

This historical version had no formal installer or complete product entry point for ordinary users. Its source state corresponds to commit [`0998265`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/commit/0998265e54096456878fb81c35d815856e2246bd). Install the latest stable Release for current use.
